payout_quote: Official Skooli Help Center 'How much are tutors paid?': 'Tutors are paid a competitive hourly rate. Although hourly rates are set, the tutors' earnings are calculated per minute for all completed tutoring sessions.' And: 'Once this grace period has passed there is a 15 minute minimum payment, so if you complete a session between 5 and 15 minutes in length tutors will be paid for 15 minutes of tutoring.'
steps: Apply as a Skooli tutor (teaching credentials/subject expertise required).
Get approved and join Skooli's scheduled tutoring program.
Tutor scheduled online sessions; earnings calculated per minute of completed sessions.
No-shows: wait 15 minutes in the classroom and receive 15 minutes of pay; sessions of 5–15 minutes pay the 15-minute minimum.
catches: No dollar amount is published — 'competitive hourly rate' is set by Skooli but the figure is undisclosed.
You must be available for scheduled sessions; no-shows pay only the 15-minute minimum.
Earnings are per minute of completed sessions only; unscheduled time is unpaid.
Selective application (credentials required); scheduling is managed by Skooli.
biggest_catch: Skooli publishes no dollar pay rate — only 'competitive hourly rate' paid per minute with a 15-minute minimum — so your actual earnings are unknown until you're hired and scheduled.
eligibility: Teaching credentials/subject expertise; approved Skooli tutor application.
timing: Paid per completed session (per-minute calculation); scheduled sessions.
